headline: Khaitan and CAM act on Embio securing investment from True North
sum: PE firm True North took a minority stake in API maker Embio — Khaitan for the company, CAM for the investor, across a full multi-practice diligence.
detail: Embio Limited secured an investment from True North, which acquired a minority stake. Khaitan & Co advised Embio across corporate, IP, employment, real estate and litigation due diligence; Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised True North across corporate, pharma/healthcare, IP, employment, CCI and real-estate workstreams. Embio manufactures complex high-value APIs and advanced intermediates.

sources.name: Bar & Bench — Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “Embio Limited has secured an investment from True North, pursuant to which the investor has acquired a minority stake in the company.” — details the full Khaitan and CAM multi-practice teams.

timeline.t: True North acquires minority stake in Embio
